source.title: More Star Lotus
source.description: We still need more Star Lotus to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Seradane and bring me back some.
source.objective: Gather 10 Star Lotus in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Thank you. Your services will be remembered.
